# lean-pkg formalization

formalization.yaml (v0.4, what Palomar reads): render it from the registry and the repo at HEAD; anchor the companion to one arXiv version.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg formalization [--json] COMMAND
```

## Subcommands

- [`lean-pkg formalization render`](formalization-render.md): render formalization.yaml (v0.4, what Palomar reads) from the registry and the repo at HEAD; stdout unless --write/--out (`formalization NAME` is the same)
- [`lean-pkg formalization anchor`](formalization-anchor.md): bind the companion to one posted arXiv version (writes package files, never the registry)
- [`lean-pkg formalization kept`](formalization-kept.md): the canonical kept view of formalization.yaml (derived keys removed) and its SHA-256, for a release-input audit; --against REV: exit 1 when a kept key changed (read-only)

## Details

formalization.yaml (mathlib-initiative v0.4, what Palomar reads): [`formalization render`](formalization-render.md) renders it from the registry and the repo at HEAD (`formalization NAME` is the same), and [`formalization anchor`](formalization-anchor.md) binds the companion to one posted arXiv version, and [`formalization kept`](formalization-kept.md) prints the canonical kept view and its SHA-256. See [formalization.yaml](../formalization.md).

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `formalization` (exit 0): `headline`, `main_results`, `name`, `ok`, `path`, `placeholders`, `registry_updated`, `unchanged`, `validation`, `warnings`, `written`, `yaml`
